about: Thresholds for the contact frequency audit. scripts/frequency_distribution.py reads this file and takes its CLI defaults from it, so change a rule here and nowhere else. Rates and shares are percentages. The default caps are widely quoted rules of thumb, not Bloomreach limits. Each key is explained under notes.

notes.window_days: Default window in days. 28 makes 'per week' exact (4 weeks); for a monthly view use 28 or 30 and read the per-window figures.
notes.thresholds: Messages per window at which each frequency bucket starts, per channel (read by the call plan in SKILL.md: one customer count per threshold and metric). Buckets run from one threshold to just under the next; the last is open-ended. Keep 4 to 6 per channel: each threshold costs one EQL query per metric.
notes.channel_filters: The campaign event's action_type and the status that means 'received', per channel (read by the call plan in SKILL.md). Tested values: email is delivered; SMS and mobile push record sent, not delivered; push is 'mobile notification' (with a space) and web push 'browser notification'. Check the project's own values first.
notes.optout_statuses: Statuses that count as opting out (read by the call plan in SKILL.md): a customer with any of them in the window counts once. Use the project's names (some use unsubscribe and complaint).
notes.engaged_status: The status that counts as engaged (read by the call plan in SKILL.md): a customer with at least one in the window. Clicks, not opens: opens are inflated by mail privacy features.
notes.min_bucket_customers: A bucket with fewer customers than this is shown but not judged, and can't be the reference bucket.
notes.fatigue_ratio: A bucket is fatigued when its opt-out rate is at least this many times the reference bucket's (the first judged bucket) and at least fatigue_min_points higher.
notes.fatigue_min_points: Minimum opt-out rate increase, in percentage points, over the reference bucket for fatigue to count.
notes.engagement_drop_ratio: A bucket is also fatigued when its engaged share is at least this fraction (0.25 = 25%) lower than the previous judged bucket's. Engagement normally rises with frequency (more chances to click), so a fall is a strong signal.
notes.share_high_pct: When at least this percentage of recipients is at or above the first fatigued bucket (or over the chosen cap), the channel is high priority; otherwise fatigue is medium.
notes.coverage_min_pct: When fewer than this percentage of the customers who opted out in the window received the channel in the window, per-bucket opt-out rates understate the problem (identity gaps, or opt-outs from other sources); the result carries a warning.
notes.default_caps_per_week: Rule-of-thumb caps used only when the data shows no fatigue (or too little data), labelled as such: email about 3 a week for promotional mail, SMS about 1 a week, mobile push about 5 a week. Tune them to the brand and the customers' consent terms.
